scope: Actual WebGL2 desktop and phone Chromium layouts at Medium quality. Native forest and river chapter entry, production visual cache warming, observed renderer submissions and original collision queries. View steering changes orientation only. The two explicitly labelled daylight bank images override renderer atmosphere/episode ambient for material inspection; original night clock and all actor/gameplay state remain unchanged. No mission success, health or player position is assigned. Physical Safari, human difficulty and hardware frame rate are not tested.
